sources.title: cadamcat/artin-primitive-roots-lean4 README

sources.result: Records formalization of all-admissible-integer infinitude and OpenAI’s x/(log x)^2 lower bound; used as an input library in this repository.

inferences: For positive bases, the negative-square obstruction beta in Anwar–Pappalardi p.35 is impossible. The remaining odd-subset square obstruction is exactly SQ. Thus positive density under GRH in this domain is prior art.
A positive density asymptotic gives a positive x/log x lower bound in every sufficiently large dyadic interval by subtraction at 2x and x.
A cumulative lower bound alone does not supply the same dyadic conclusion without further information.

difference_from_pinned_openai_statements: For nonsquare positive a ≥ 2, singleton specialization strengthens the stated x/(log x)^2 lower-bound scale to x/log x.

The simultaneous target allows arbitrary nonempty finite positive integer sets satisfying SQ, including composite bases, with x/log x lower bound and no external analytic hypotheses in the public Lean theorem.
not_new_as_standalone_ideas: General simultaneous bases under conditional results
All-admissible-base infinitude as already claimed by OpenAI
Single-base infinitude formalization as already recorded by the upstream Lean project
